svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of workers in informal employment: agriculture vs.
Share of employed people working in jobs that lack basic social or legal protection and employment benefits. Does not
include illegal and illicit activities. The agricultural sector includes agriculture, forestry, and fishing.
Share of workers in informal employment in the non-agricultural sector
Share of workers in informal employment in the agricultural sector

tspan.tspan: Figures refer to national estimates and may not be fully comparable across countries. Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS

text.tspan: and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming. Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest
year between 2015 and 2024 is shown instead.
